title: Q-EXP-cd9db55b: close the durable-execution gap with a measured change
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** every rnd pass
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rnd --proved durable-execution
**Prediction:** pageviews_7d >= 1310 within 336 h
**Status:** closed

Experiment from R&D finding `gap:durable-execution`.
Hypothesis: 5 competitors evidence 'an agent run survives a crash or restart and resumes from its last completed step'; building it should move the metric
Metric: pageviews_7d. Ship the smallest change the proof `file:seed/worker/src/checkpoint.js` shows, then compare the metric against its baseline in doctrine/growth.json; a miss reverts the change and lowers the finding's priority.

**Out of scope:** rebuilding a competitor's product, claims about a competitor beyond what its own page states, and any change without a test.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation rnd --proved durable-execution

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-26T14:01:50Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.1 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
